page.overview:
What is Amon-Gorloth?

Amon-Gorloth is a fictional deity created by David Calvo for the Call of Cthulhu scenario "Les Yeux d'Amon", featured in issue #101 of the French role-playing magazine Casus Belli.

Amon-Gorloth is a mysterious Great Old One who once dwelled in a great palace known as Gz-eh, close to the Valley of the Kings. His dreaming force had the ability to reshape reality, making the Nile Valley flourish 3,000 years ago until the stars ceased to be right. Amon-Gorloth was entombed beneath the ground in the Sahara Desert. His cult is similar to that of the Egyptian god Amun, and his loyal priests built secret mausoleums to access the entity's body, where they sacrifice cattle to please him.
